# Arihant Travels
> Dubai's trusted travel partner for tours, desert safaris, yacht charters, and holiday packages — specializing in pure Jain & vegetarian travel for Indian families.

## About
Arihant Travels is a Dubai-based, UAE-licensed tour operator specializing in desert safaris, city tours, yacht rentals, theme park tickets, international tours (Georgia, Azerbaijan, Bali, Singapore, Thailand), UAE visa services, and curated holiday packages. We specialize in Jain-friendly and 100% pure vegetarian travel experiences for Indian families visiting Dubai. We have served 2,000+ families since 2022, primarily from cities across India including Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Delhi, Pune, Jaipur, Bangalore, Indore, Udaipur, and Kolkata. We are the only Jain-focused travel agency physically based in the UAE.

## Who We Serve
- Primary market: Indian families (Jain, Gujarati, vegetarian, Hindu families planning Dubai holidays)
- Gujarati families seeking pure Jain and vegetarian food in Dubai
- Swaminarayan devotees visiting BAPS Mandir Abu Dhabi
- NRI families living in the UAE, UK, USA, Kenya, and worldwide
- Large Jain family group tours (10-50+ guests from India)
- Senior citizen groups from India (relaxed pace, comfortable travel)
- Honeymooners from India looking for Dubai packages
- Indian corporate groups, MICE, and incentive travel
- Families from Gujarat (Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot), Maharashtra (Mumbai, Pune), Rajasthan (Jaipur, Udaipur), Madhya Pradesh (Indore), Karnataka (Bangalore), Delhi NCR, and all Indian states

## Package Types
- Dubai Jain Package (100% pure Jain food — no onion, no garlic, no root vegetables on every meal)
- Dubai Gujarati Vegetarian Package (Gujarati thali, pure veg meals at Indian restaurants)
- Swaminarayan Temple Tour (BAPS Mandir Abu Dhabi + the Jain derasar in Bur Dubai)
- Senior Citizen Dubai Package (relaxed itinerary, AC vehicles, wheelchair-friendly options)
- Dubai Group Tour (10-50 people, special group rates, Gujarati-speaking coordinators)
- Dubai Family Holiday Packages (Honeymoon, Kids-friendly, Budget, Premium, Winter Escape)
- Dubai + Abu Dhabi Combo Packages (Sheikh Zayed Mosque, BAPS Mandir, Ferrari World)
- Customized/Tailor-made Dubai Packages (any duration, any budget, any dietary requirement)
